name: mapos
description: Assets do Map-OS: Tailwind CSS e bibliotecas de JavaScript

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:vendor && npm run build:stickers
scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -i assets/src/app.css -o assets/dist/app.css --minify && tailwindcss -i assets/src/layout.css -o assets/dist/layout.css --minify && tailwindcss -i assets/src/imprimir.css -o assets/dist/imprimir.css --minify && tailwindcss -i assets/src/instalador.css -o install/assets/css/instalador.css --minify && npm run build:pdf
